# identifier url

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:identifierUrl`](gmeow-identifierUrl.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/identifierUrl>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The authority URL that resolves an identifier record — e.g. the geni profile page, the ORCID record URL, the ROR landing page. The resolvable counterpart of the scheme-local [`gmeow:identifierValue`](gmeow-identifierValue.md); projects to schema:PropertyValue/url. Range is intentionally open (an IRI).
